title: Silent's Gems 1.7.10x16
description: A resource pack that converts the 32x32 textures for Silent's Gems 1.7.10 to 16x16 for consistency.
body:
Scales down all of the textures using David's Batch Processor on GIMP.

May have transparency issues. (Most likely will not be fixed.)

This was made for a personal pack when I noticed only the Silent's Gems textures were a different resolution than the others.
